correctedFields.value: Strongest feature: The move supplies the personal-ground bridge by connecting objective, necessary, timeless, immaterial, transcendent logical attributes to a proposed mind, giving the constructive case direction and relevance. Principal limitation: Its eliminative language compresses transitions, treating problems for naturalism and Platonism as leaving agency without exhausting impersonal alternatives or establishing why abstract necessity, timelessness, or causal inertness indicates personality. Live burden: The case must distinguish grounding from explanation, demonstrate why truths reside in a mind, and compare noncausal Platonist or fundamentalist accounts instead of declaring their failure. Locked score: The mixed band reflects excellent central-burden contact but materially overstated force, incomplete comparative warrant, unstable terminology, and an underdeveloped inference from logical attributes to an omnipotent personal ground.

Strongest feature: The move puts the grounding demand at the debate’s center and distinguishes the proposed divine ground from a contingent posit, establishing a relevant constructive route. Principal limitation: Describing God as self-existing and necessary does not establish why that description answers an explanatory request unavailable to logical facts themselves, while brute fact, necessity, and self-existence remain insufficiently differentiated. Live burden: The argument must provide a reason necessary logical relations cannot be fundamental, explain what work divine necessity performs, and avoid granting God an exemption through redescriptive terminology. Locked score: The mixed band records relevance and a thesis alongside materially overstated necessity, limited evidential warrant, incomplete engagement with necessary-brute alternatives, and an explanatory asymmetry that remains unsupported.
